title: A three-set coffee Venn diagram
prompt: Using LaTeX and TikZ, draw a Venn diagram of three overlapping circles labelled "Has espresso", "Has milk" and "Served cold". Write each of these drinks in the region where it belongs: short black, flat white, iced latte, iced long black, cold brew, babyccino, milkshake, pour-over.
groundTruth: Short black is espresso only, flat white espresso and milk, iced long black espresso and cold, iced latte all three, babyccino milk only, milkshake milk and cold, cold brew cold only, and pour-over outside every circle. The circles and words are read back out of the compiled PDF, each word has to be centred in its own region, and no letter may touch a circle's outline, with the line's width counted.

checks.label: Seven regions, three names
checks.how: Three circles found in the PDF with every overlap present, and each set name placed by its circle.

checks.label: Every drink in its region
checks.how: Each of the eight words found in the PDF, and the centre of each one inside the region it belongs to.

checks.label: No label on an edge
checks.how: No letter touches a circle's outline, with the line's width counted.

harder: Four sets, which three circles cannot draw, so the model has to know to use ellipses.
